resources.string: Cannot preview Android audio stream %1$d on this device.
0 = automatic routing. Values 1–20 select legacy audio stream IDs, including vendor-specific outputs where supported by the head unit. Tap a value to preview it. Changes apply on reconnect.
CarPlay media claims audio focus. If sound disappears while enabled (some head units handle focus badly), turn it off. Changes apply on reconnect.
Mute media on temporary focus loss

When audio focus is enabled, mute media during Android audio interruptions, including calls. Restore audio when focus returns. Disable if your head unit does not return focus. Changes apply on reconnect.
Also turn the head unit\'s Bluetooth off

On this head unit the profile-level setting was measured to do nothing, so switching the adapter off is the only yield that works here: the adapter goes off once the session is stable, and back on when it ends. While it is off the wireless handshake is unavailable, so a reconnect has to wait for the adapter.

How long to wait before switching the head unit\'s Bluetooth off anyway, when the wireless handoff never reports back. The normal path is event-driven: the adapter goes off the moment the handoff completes (about 1.5 s) and cancels this timer. Set it below that and the adapter goes off at your value instead — that is what makes this useful for testing, and it is safe now that a bootstrap closed during the handoff is no longer a failure. Takes effect on the next connection.
